overview: A personal control center for a cross-app AI agent on the Internet Computer — describe goals in chat, get Claude-optimized plans, save reusable workflows, and manage on-chain preferences.
features: Log in with Internet Identity and see your principal
Describe cross-dApp goals in a chat and get structured plans optimized for Claude + ICP MCP
Refine plans through conversation and copy them to clipboard
Save plans as reusable workflows with tags and favorites
Search, edit, duplicate, delete, and export workflows as markdown
Store preferred dApps, canister IDs, personal rules, and persistent notes on-chain
Dashboard with recent plans, workflow count, and onboarding for new users
History log of all generated plans with timestamps and re-open support
